{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check status distribution for loyal customers
status_counts = df_loyal['status'].value_counts(dropna=False)
print(status_counts)

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal orders with converted = 1
conversion_rate_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].mean()
print(conversion_rate_loyal)"}
